messages:
Alex M.: FYI Acme Bank requested a single-page "EU processing boundary" artifact + a CSV of subprocessors showing purpose and EU residency. Need delivery by EOD Thursday. Can the POC team own this? :calendar:

Jordan L.: I can mock a public-friendly diagram. Plan: ingress (EU LB) -> EU inference pool -> ephemeral cache -> encrypted object store. Will remove internal hostnames and creds.

Priya S.: Quick flags: runtime caches are ephemeral and stay in-region for EU customers. Telemetry aggregates are processed in EU by default but we have a few vendor pipelines in scope  will confirm exact datacenter locations and retention.

Sam R.: Confirming telemetry vendors: metrics are batched in eu-west1, error alerts forwarded to PagerX EU endpoints. Retention default = 30d for metrics, 90d for debug logs (scrubbed). I'll paste links to vendor pages.

Casey W.: KMS options: (1) Redwood-managed keys in eu-west1 (default POC), (2) Customer-managed keys in EU KMS (bring-your-own), (3) Enterprise HSM via partner/on-prem (enterprise). Indicate which option for the POC.

Alex M.: Also include a short "what we redact" note for support traces: no raw prompt text, hashes for stack frames, timestamps only. Make clear support access is logged & audited.

Jordan L.: Deliverable list I propose: 1) single-page PNG diagram (public-friendly) 2) subprocessors.csv (columns: name, purpose, residency, data types, compliance links) 3) 1-pg Q&A with short answers.

Priya S.: CSV sample rows I'll add: CloudInfraEU, Hosting, eu-west1, compute+storage, SOC2/ISO27001 URL; ObsVendorEU, Metrics, eu-west1, aggregated telemetry, retention 30d; AlertVendorEU, Alerting, eu-west*, alerts only, link.

Sam R.: Adding links: https://pagervendor.example/eu-locations and metrics SLA doc. Will attach in the CSV "evidence_link" column.

Casey W.: KMS blurb ready. Also add a note: if customer requests cross-region backup, must be explicit opt-in and documented in SOW.

LegalBot: Draft legal sentence suggestion: "For Customer accounts configured for EU region processing, Redwood will store and process Customer Data within EU jurisdictions unless Customer explicitly enables cross-region features. Redwood does not use Customer Data to train models. Subprocessor roster is maintained and updated with notice per contract."

Alex M.: Good. Assignments: Jordan = diagram, Priya = CSV + Q&A draft, Sam = vendor links + retention evidence, Casey = KMS paragraph and SE handoff note, LegalBot = finalize sentence. Target EOD Thursday.

Jordan L.: I'll post the PNG draft in this thread when ready. Planning a 2-column layout: left = flow, right = short bullets on residency + KMS.

Priya S.: I'll include a short table explaining what we redact and typical retention windows. Will export CSV and a downloadable link.

Sam R.: Done - I'll DM legal the vendor evidence for sign-off on retention wording.

Alex M.: Thanks team. If we hit blockers ping me. :thumbsup:
